create_COMVelocityEstimator: create a COMVelocityEstimator instance with a robot object and default window size of 20
update_velocity_estimate: call update on the COMVelocityEstimator to compute filtered CoM velocity from robot base sensors
get_com_velocity_world_frame: access the com_velocity_world_frame property to retrieve the filtered center of mass velocity in world coordinates
get_com_velocity_body_yaw_aligned_frame: access the com_velocity_body_yaw_aligned_frame property to retrieve velocity projected in the body aligned inertial frame
reset_velocity_filters: call reset on the COMVelocityEstimator to reinitialize the moving window filters for x, y, and z velocity axes
